fills.researcher_notes: The wiki's candidate value ('Focus Energy') is WRONG for this specific fact -- I am filling a different value than the flag suggested, per protocol ('decide which side is wrong, with evidence'). Two genuinely separate-origin sources agree the pipeline itself (not the upstream gas field) is built AND operated by GAIL: (1) the PNGRB NGPL common-carrier register (2024 edition; row 29, 'Langtala to Ramgarh', Entity=GAIL, matching the sheet's own length/capacity to two decimals -- this is the regulator's own authorisation-holder field, and PNGRB's own convention treats the authorised entity as the operating entity for these small dedicated evacuation lines); (2) nsenergybusiness.com (GlobalData), reporting on the 2010 field-facility completion, states verbatim: 'GAIL was to install and commission a 90km gas pipeline between SGL gas field and the downstream consumer -- a 110MW power plant owned by Rajasthan State Government at Ramgarh (RRUVNL)', and separately (same publisher, different 2009 article on the GAIL-RRVUNL gas supply agreement signing) 'GAIL is laying the pipeline at an estimated investment of approximately INR1 billion... Diameter: 10 inches, Length: 90 kilometers'. offshore-technology.com (also GlobalData, same network as nsenergybusiness so NOT counted as an independent second source) corroborates with identical wording ('a dedicated 6" gas pipeline of ca. 90 km (owned by GAIL)... Focus Energy Limited operates the Block RJ-ON/6 itself, but GAIL owns and operates the transmission pipeline'), i.e. this source explicitly draws the same field-vs-pipeline distinction I am making. Wikipedia's Ramgarh Gas Thermal Power Station article incidentally corroborates too ('Power station houses the GAIL terminal for the supply of gas fuel') but is too thin to count as a citable source on its own. CONCLUSION: Focus Energy operates the upstream SGL gas field/Block RJ-ON/6 (this is a genuinely different pipeline-adjacent fact, and is exactly what the wiki infobox is actually reflecting -- a field/pipeline conflation), while GAIL both owns (already the sheet's Owner value, unchanged) AND operates this 88 km evacuation pipeline to the RRVUNL Ramgarh plant. Never cited gem.wiki or globalenergymonitor.org.
